caption: The drawing depicts an indoor showroom with a glass roof and large arched windows, through which a garden with trees and shrubs is visible. Inside the showroom, various gravestones, tomb monuments, and funerary sculptures are arranged on a checkered black-and-white floor. These include upright headstones, a tall obelisk, several sculpted angels with outstretched wings, urns atop pedestals, a detailed marble lamb figure on a rectangular base, a sundial, a cross monument, and sculpted plaques. Most of the monuments are gray or white marble, some are black or reddish-brown stone, and engraved inscriptions such as "HARDLY," "INNOCENT," "BELOVED," "PRECIOUS," and "RIP" are visible. Green plants in decorative pots are placed by the windows and throughout the room. Three gold or brass chandeliers with spherical elements hang from the ceiling. At the back, a pinkish upholstered bench with intricate wrought iron armrests sits near the windows, and the word "MONUMENT" appears in reverse on the window, indicating signage or a label seen from inside. The overall color scheme consists of cool greens, grays, and whites, with accents of gold and pink.
title: Monument Display Room, 1888
